task_message:
Case N19: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 221x221x187 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:

- **Segmentation**: single connected component, 17.9 mL, created with one positive point prompt and refined once with the model; checked slice-by-slice in all three planes, including just past each end, with no residual lesion tissue found outside the mask and no candidate corrections proposed.
